newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian L&H record earnings before charges.
newsitem.headline: Belgian L&H record earnings before charges.

text.p: Net per share (dollars) 0.59 loss vs 0.28 loss
NOTE - Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products NV, a Belgian speech technology firm listed on Nasdaq, said it posted record revenue and earnings before one-time charges.
Net per share (dollars) 0.53 loss vs 1.67 loss
NOTE - L&H said net income before a one-time charge was $2.50 million in Q4 and $3.58 million in 1996. EPS before the charge was $0.14 in Q4 and $0.21 in 1996.

NOTE - L&H said the $0.5 million tax bill was related to the company's recent acquisitions. There was a one-time write-off of $11.5 million of the acquired in-process research and development for Berkeley Speech Technologies of the U.S.
It bought BST in November for $15.5 million in cash.

It said fourth quarter revenue included about $5.5 million from core speech technologies, $5.4 million from Mendez translation services, bought in September, and $2.5 million from its continuous dictation project.
